short_description.value: Motorbike ride tracker, running costs and service reminders in one app.

full_description.value:
MotoVault is the motorcycle tracker for riders: GPS ride tracking, expense tracking with receipt scanning, and maintenance reminders, in one app built for motorcycles, not cars.

Record every ride, log every petrol fill-up and garage bill, and get reminded before your next service is due. Your ride log, your costs and your service history live in one garage on your phone.

--------------------------
WHAT YOU CAN DO
--------------------------

* TRACK EVERY RIDE - Hit record and ride. MotoVault logs your GPS route, distance, moving time, climb and max lean angle, and builds a logbook of every mile you have ridden. Export any ride as GPX.

* TRACK EVERY EXPENSE - Every fill-up, every part, every garage bill. See what your bike really costs per mile, per month and per year. Logging is free and unlimited, always.

* SCAN A RECEIPT INSTEAD OF TYPING - Point your camera at a petrol, parts or garage receipt. MotoVault reads the parts, the labour, the total and the date, and fills the expense in for you.

* NEVER MISS A SERVICE - Oil changes, chain adjustments, tyre swaps, valve checks. Set reminders by mileage or by date and get a heads-up before the next interval is due.

* KEEP THE FULL SERVICE HISTORY - Every job logged with date, odometer and cost. A complete record that backs you up when you sell.

* YOUR GARAGE - Specs, odometer, next service and running costs for your bike, on one screen. 12,000+ motorcycle models in the catalog.

* PLAN EVERY TRIP - Map the weekend loop or the big tour. Save routes, drop waypoints and share the plan with your group.

* YOUR SEASON IN ONE RECAP - Total miles, rides, your longest ride and the countries you rode through, ready to share.

--------------------------
WHY RIDERS SWITCH TO MOTOVAULT
--------------------------

- One motorcycle app instead of three: ride tracker, expense tracker and maintenance log together
- Date reminders for the MOT, insurance or anything else that comes round once a year
- Service reminders by mileage or by date, so you stop guessing when the oil is due
- Receipt scanning reads the parts, the labour and the total so logging takes seconds
- Miles or kilometers, light or dark: the app follows your choice
- Your data is yours: private, exportable, never sold

--------------------------
WHO IT'S FOR
--------------------------

- Commuters who ride every day and want the bike kept right
- Weekend riders chasing the next good road
- Adventure and touring riders logging long trips
- Home mechanics who do their own wrenching
- Anyone tired of car apps that treat motorcycles as an afterthought

--------------------------
MOTOVAULT PRO
--------------------------

Free forever includes 1 bike, unlimited maintenance and expense logging, unlimited ride recording, 1 AI diagnostic scan per month and 3 receipt scans per month. MotoVault Pro unlocks additional bikes, unlimited AI diagnostics, unlimited receipt scans, unlimited GPX exports and offline trip maps.

Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Google Play account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://motovault.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://motovault.app/terms

--------------------------

Questions? Feedback? We read every email: support@motovault.app

Two wheels. One app. Ride better.
